entities.name: Sita Varma
entities.description: A respected engineer from Avishkar who secretly led a double life as the masked racer Spitfire.

entities.name: Mohar Varma
entities.description: Sita's father, a former Consulate member who staged a coup and was incarcerated.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Chief Engineer who designed Sita's exosuit and co-led the Aether Rangers.

entities.name: Chandra
entities.description: Pia's daughter, racer of the Cloudspire Racing Team and Sita's rival turned friend.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Mind mage who interrupted the race to recover Loot.

entities.name: Aether Rangers
entities.description: Racing team Sita co-led as star pilot.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: Governing body of which Mohar was a member.

entities.name: Aetherdrift
entities.description: Place Sita's exosuit shunts her into.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which Sita's mother was killed.

events.summary: Sita's mother is killed in the New Phyrexian Invasion, and Sita puts her engineering to work as Spitfire.
events.quote: Sita's mother was killed in the New Phyrexian Invasion

events.summary: Sita and Pia Nalaar co-lead the Aether Rangers in the Ghirapur Grand Prix; Sita and Chandra find mutual respect.
events.quote: They later found mutual respect after realizing that they were much alike

events.summary: A coup by her father stops Sita near the finish and reveals her identity.
events.quote: she was stopped by a sudden coup started by her father, which caused her identity to be revealed

events.summary: Sita rescues Chandra and Pia from Jace Beleren but all three are knocked unconscious; Nissa Revane rescues them and Elspeth Tirel heals them.
events.quote: all three were rendered unconscious by the mind mage, only being rescued by Nissa Revane and healed by Elspeth Tirel

events.summary: After the race Sita becomes the city's fastest taxi driver, ignoring her incarcerated father.
events.quote: she became the city's fastest taxi driver

relations.quote: Sita is the wealthy daughter of Mohar Varma
her unique exosuit, designed by Pia Nalaar
Sita co-led the Aether Rangers as its star pilot

relations.note: knocked her out while recovering Loot
relations.quote: rescue Chandra and Pia from Jace Beleren
